one_liner: DataForSEO offers a broad pay-as-you-go REST API for SEO data (SERP, keywords, backlinks, etc.) with Basic auth, a free sandbox, $1 trial credit, and an official MCP server.
auth_notes: The REST API uses only HTTP Basic (API login + generated API password). OAuth2 authorization-code exists only for the MCP server (mcp.dataforseo.com), not the REST API, so Basic is primary for a toolkit.
access_notes: Free signup gives credentials, a free Sandbox with dummy data, and $1 trial credit that never expires. Production use is pay-as-you-go with a $50 minimum top-up; no subscription.
blocker_notes: Real data needs a prepaid balance ($50 minimum), but free credentials, sandbox and trial credit allow building immediately.

evidence.quote: DataForSEO is using the [Basic Authentication](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Basic_access_authentication), which makes it possible to call our APIs with almost any programming language
Authentication](https://docs.dataforseo.com/v3/auth/) is HTTP Basic and nothing else: there is no separate auth call, and credentials cannot be passed as URL parameters.
**OAuth 2.0 (default for HTTP MCP):** works out of the box. MCP clients discover the DataForSEO authorization server via Protected Resource metadata
